svg.title: The destination zone in Zonogy. Minimizing a window leaves its zone empty: that zone becomes the destination, marked by a glow, with the Launcher open in it to pick the window that fills it. When every zone is full, a new window floats above the tiles, and it is minimized when a window it covers is focused.
svg.text: An emptied zone becomes the destination, with the Launcher open in it
When every zone is full, new windows open in the floating zone
A floating zone window is minimized when you focus one it covers
